title: Design System: Angel Tree Services — Admin Dashboard

scope.description: Surface-specific exception to PRODUCT.md public-website light-mode preference. Do not inherit this system solely because a file is under app/admin. Existing narrower design documents remain unchanged.

extensions.colorRampPolicy: No synthesized ramps: this scoped contract records only implemented colors under the user instruction not to invent colors.

narrative.overview:
The user-pinned Robinhood portfolio/day board brings retained cash and the next work to handle into one operating surface. Graphite, warm white, a single lime accent, open chart space, tabular figures, hairline divisions, and compact task rows carry the implemented direction. The dashboard prioritizes both daily work and money.

This is a dashboard-specific design system. Its dark appearance is an explicit exception to PRODUCT.md’s public-website light-mode preference. It preserves the existing CRM navigation, role boundaries, record destinations, and shared components. There are no shipping raster assets; the PNG captures are review evidence only.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite surfaces with warm white text and one lime action/chart accent.
Large tabular money figures, with financial basis and date window visible.
Flat chart and queue sections; bounded operational previews behind native disclosures.
Responsive dashboard content inside the existing opt-in CRM shell.

rules.name: The Dashboard Boundary Rule
rules.body: Apply this document only to /admin’s dashboard implementation and its explicitly opted-in .dashboard-dark frame. This file’s directory placement does not extend its guidance to descendant admin routes, employee or document surfaces, the public website, customer portals, crew tools, or files.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime identifies the primary action, selected reporting period, chart, selected navigation icon, and active links. Peach communicates overdue balances or attention; it is not a second promotional accent.

rules.name: The Numeric Basis Rule
rules.body: Keep money and counts tabular. Pair the largest figure with its actual reporting window and basis; do not add invented growth percentages, trend deltas, or profit claims.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: The dashboard’s chart, priorities, agenda, and workflow use space and hairline dividers for hierarchy. Do not turn the opening surface into a decorative card grid.

rules.name: The Verified Data Rule
rules.body: A verified zero is valid data. Unavailable totals, incomplete chart reads, and unconfirmed workflow counts remain explicit unavailable states; never substitute a plausible curve or a false zero.

rules.name: The Preview Boundary Rule
rules.body: Preserve the visible preview/window labels and full-area links. A loaded list length is not a company-wide total.

dos: Do keep this dark system confined to the /admin dashboard and the explicitly opted-in .dashboard-dark shell.
Do preserve the user’s dark, bold-number, high-contrast chart direction and the CRM’s existing navigation identity.
Do show the actual date window, business timezone, financial basis, and refresh time where the implemented components provide them.
Do preserve the chart’s keyboard interaction and exact-amount table alongside pointer access.
Do retain unavailable, loading, empty-preview, and role-sensitive variants with their honest labels.
Do link each priority and workflow row to the queue that implements its stated action.
donts: Don't apply this file to all admin routes, the website, customer portals, crew tools, employee/document screens, or files.
Don't serialize or reveal company cash and invoice fields to sales-only reporting roles.
Don't label cash collected as profit, use invoice totals as cash, or compare date-scoped values with all-date balances without their labels.
Don't invent growth metrics, replace unavailable data with zero, or draw an unreconciled cash timeline.
Don't present bounded preview lengths as complete business totals or remove the paths to full queues.
Don't add shipping raster assets, decorative card grids, extra eyebrow labels, or display tracking tighter than the implemented -.04em.
